intervention_class: sustained hyperpolarising input current, families STIM-1 and STIM-2 (modeling abstraction, not a device setting)

STIM-1.contact_rule: bipolar SEEG channel (P2 montage, 191 channels) with the largest gain to the top-1 estimated EZ region

STIM-2.contact_rule: the two bipolar channels with the largest summed gain to the estimated EZ set
STIM-2.weights: sum of the two gain rows, scaled to max 1

waveform.shape: constant (DC-like) from t=0 for the whole horizon

physical_mapping.mapping: SpatEpiStimHyp: explicit input I_hyp_i = amp * w_i added to the excitability equation ds=(1/tau0)(4(u1 - x0 + I_hyp - H) - s); w = contact gain row normalised to max 1; x0 itself unchanged
physical_mapping.field_or_VTA_estimate: gain row used as a reciprocity proxy for the stimulation field (Wang-style weighting); no VTA model

constraints.eloquent_cortex: not_reported (virtual patient; no functional mapping) - not applied
constraints.contact_positions: reported_absent (no MRI / electrode coordinates, A0010); contacts are identified only by bipolar channel name and gain row
constraints.reserved_outcomes: not used; candidates are rules applied to the fitted EZ estimate only
constraints.interpretation: virtual intervention on a model; research evidence, not a clinical recommendation
constraints.safety_limits: charge density not assessable: amplitudes are model units with no mapping to mA or contact surface area
constraints.numerical: dt = 0.05 ms; per-region Istim must stay <= ~0.04 (single-node test: NaN at 0.04 with dt 0.1 ms, stable to 0.045 at 0.05 ms; raw-gain weights (max 88) are numerically infeasible)

feasibility_verdict: feasible_in_silico (model units; not a device setting)
status_note: rule committed before any P2 model existed (T0015); concrete contacts are derived in the simulation task
